# Fonts for the launcher

Embedded into the runner (`src/launcher_fonts.S.in`) and drawn with
stb_truetype: Inter for text, Metamorphous for the title, tabs, setting
names and buttons. Both are unmodified and under the SIL Open Font License
1.1, which allows embedding and bundling them with any software provided
each copy carries the copyright notice and the licence (the release
packages include `OFL-Inter.txt` and `OFL-Metamorphous.txt`) and neither
is sold by itself. "Metamorphous" is a Reserved Font Name: a modified
version would have to be renamed.

| File | Source | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `Inter-Regular.ttf`, `Inter-SemiBold.ttf` | Inter 4.1, https://github.com/rsms/inter/releases/download/v4.1/Inter-4.1.zip (`extras/ttf/`) | `40d692fce188e4471e2b3cba937be967878f631ad3ebbbdcd587687c7ebe0c82`, `78a843fade9d4612a5567302fb595b56976eb5fcebf4fea5a5912d638bafcde3` |
